dedupe_keys.name: galileo constellation status and satellite notices gsc

description: The Galileo constellation information page lists every Galileo satellite with its name (for example GSAT0101), space-vehicle identifier, clock type (RAFS or PHM), status (USABLE or NOT USABLE) and the active Notice Advisory to Galileo Users (NAGU) number, type and subject. On the day read, several satellites carried notices, for example GSAT0201 and GSAT0202 marked not usable under NAGU 2021008, GSAT0204 removed from active service since 2017-12-08 for constellation management, and GSAT0210 removed from active service. Producer: the GSC, the Galileo service centre operated for EUSPA. Coverage: the whole Galileo constellation, which serves users worldwide. Access: a public HTML table with no login, plus a link to the Galileo helpdesk for questions and product requests; no bulk file was seen. Licence and cost: free to view; no licence is stated. Caveats: the page is a live snapshot with no history, so trends need the archived NAGU records or the quarterly performance reports. Simulation uses: it gives the current available-satellite set for GNSS availability and resilience models and for testing how outages degrade positioning. Related records: the NAGU service notices (data-gsc-galileo-nagu-service-notices) and Galileo satellite metadata (data-galileo-satellite-metadata).
